newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Wyoming well tests 2,600 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Wyoming well tests 2,600 bpd.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said Teusday a completed horizontal well in the Brady Field in Sweetwater County, Wyoming tested 2,600 barrels of oil per day and 18 million cubic feet per day of natural gas on a gross basis.
Union Pacific said it has a 50 percent working interest in the Brady 41PH which was completed in the lower Phosphoria formation.

The company said the completed Jack Knife Springs 5 well in Sweetwater County, Wyoming was currently flowing five MMcfd and 80 BOPD from the Blair formation. Union Pacific has a 56 percent working interest in this well, where it estimated gross reserves would be two to four billion cubic feet.
The company said it expected four additional wells to be drilled on the structure.
